notes.title: GeckCon - A WWF-UK Donation Drive
notes.content:
[p]Gather round, Geckos! 🦎[/p][p][b]We’re excited to launch GeckCon, a unique month-long donation drive in aid of WWF-UK to protect geckos and other incredible wildlife![/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955380/6c2a925dc793805e8ce9473e70901a29ca5ef959.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://tilt.fyi/0QivkixBT1"]You can support this important cause by donating here. Every contribution counts![/url][/p][p]
[url="http://discord.gg/x3NzEpt7"]Then join us on Discord[/url] for the full GeckCon experience, where throughout September we’ll host exclusive milestone giveaways, mini-games, special events and more surprises as we reach fundraising goals, with WWF-UK's very own Luke! [/p][p]
[b]Some highlights include:[/b][/p][p]£100: Super Rare Originals Catalogue Key Giveaway[/p][p]£200: Gecko Gods Mini Game Drop[/p][p]£300: Trivia Night with Gecko Gods Keys[/p][p]£400: WWF Animal Adoption Pack Giveaway[/p][p]£500: Gecko Gods Demo Livestream And Q&A With Gecko Influencer [url="https://www.instagram.com/geckgoals/"]GeckGoals[/url][/p][p]...and much more![/p][p]
GeckCon runs from September 2nd to October 2nd so let’s come together as a community to raise funds and have fun protecting these amazing creatures, and wildlife in general.[/p][p]
Thank you for your support![/p][p]— 💚 The Gecko Gods Team[/p]

notes.title: Discord-Exclusive Demo Screenshot Competition!

[/p][p]Our Steam Demo is still going strong, and we’ve absolutely loved seeing all the moments you’ve shared so far. Now, we’re kicking things up a notch with a special [b]Discord-only screenshot competition[/b]... and yes, there are game launch codes on the line!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955380/029fb9edcab64a69a6ba0194319caf0495ad3be5.png"][/img][/p][p][u][b]The Challenge
[/b][/u]
Capture your most [b]epic[/b], [b]hilarious[/b], [b]intense[/b], or simply [b]beautiful[/b] moments from the Demo. Whether it’s a cinematic vista, chaotic encounter, or just a perfectly-timed bug, we want to see what you’ve discovered.[/p][p][b]
[u]The Rewards[/u][/b]

We’re picking [b]two winners[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Community Favourite[/b]: The screenshot with the most emote reactions on Discord.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Developer’s Pick[/b]: Our personal favourite![/p][/*][/list][p]Both winners will receive [b]one of the very first game codes at launch[/b], delivered straight to you before the rest of the world gets access![/p][p][u][b]
How to Enter[/b][/u][/p][olist][*][p]Jump into the Demo (available on our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1290760/Gecko_Gods/"]Steam store page[/url]).[/p][/*][*][p]Snap as many screenshots as you like.[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/tsukdHjyzP"]Join our Discord server and post your screenshots individually in the #screenshot-comp channel so others can react to each one! [/url][/p][/*][*][p]That’s it![/p][/*][/olist][p][u][b]Deadline
[/b][/u]
All submissions must be posted by [b]Friday, July 18th at 4PM BST[/b]. Winner will be announced Monday, July 21st.[/p][p][u][b]Important Rules[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]You can submit multiple entries.[/p][/*][*][p]Screenshots must be your own.[/p][/*][*][p]No reposting others' content.[/p][/*][/list][p]This competition is just one of the ways we’re celebrating your creativity and time in the world of Gecko Gods. 

We can’t wait to see what you’ capture and... let the screenshot hunt begin!

- The Gecko Gods team. 💚[/p]

notes.title: Gecko Gods - Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Set sail for a world built for curiosity in Gecko Gods; a serene puzzle-adventure platformer where you explore a forgotten archipelago through the eyes of a tiny, but mighty, gecko.

Climb across sunlit ruins, weave through lush caves, and uncover the remnants of an ancient civilization, all at your own pace. With no wrong turns, every ledge, crevice, and hidden path invites discovery. Glide between islands on your small wooden boat, each stop offering new puzzles to solve, insects to snack on, and secrets to uncover.

We're so excited to release our first ever demo during Steam's Next Fest. Thank you for all the support you've given us, we'll see you later this year for the full release!

notes.content:
[h3]🦎The Gecko Gods Demo Is Coming to Steam! 🦎[/h3]

Our highly anticipated demo is finally arriving on Steam this Saturday as part of [i][b]Wholesome Direct[/b][/i]! 💚

Set sail for a world built for curiosity in [i]Gecko Gods[/i]; a serene puzzle-adventure platformer where you explore a forgotten archipelago through the eyes of a tiny, but mighty, gecko.

Climb across sunlit ruins, weave through lush caves, and uncover the remnants of an ancient civilization, all at your own pace. With no wrong turns, every ledge, crevice, and hidden path invites discovery. Glide between islands on your small wooden boat, each stop offering new puzzles to solve, insects to snack on, and secrets to uncover.

🌴 Play the [i]Gecko Gods[/i] demo for the very first time ahead of its full release later this year! Explore the opening island, uncover hidden secrets, and get a taste of the gecko's journey. 🌿

notes.title: The Gecko Gods - Development Update 🦎
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Geckos![/h2]
I want to thank you all for your patience and support throughout development. We know things have been quiet on our end, rest assured, we’ve been working hard behind the scenes to craft a game we’re truly proud of, and we hope you will love, even if it has taken longer than we originally planned

We have secured some additional funding and brought on two experienced developers to help us get the game over the finish line

I would like to thank everyone who has shown so much love and support for our project. We have some exciting announcements coming in the next few months, so stay tuned!

We look forward to bringing you The Gecko Gods later this year
[h3]- Louis Waloschek, Game Director[/h3]

notes.title: OTXO is launching on April 20th! 🩸
notes.content:
Hi there!

During Steam Next Fest back in October, we offered a fresh glimpse at OTXO, our upcoming fast-paced and dark roguelite with precise but savage gunplay and time-bending slow motion.

We're now excited to be able to share that OTXO is coming to Steam on April 20th! And in celebration of this release date announcement, you can now revisit a stream developer Lateralis and Super Rare Games' Ryan Brown hosted during Next Fest to learn more about the inexplicable, abstract Mansion you'll be able to enter in April.

If you like what you see, don't forget to wishlist the game! This will appease the Algorithm Gods™. 🙏

That's game #3 for Super Rare Originals, following Grapple Dog and LONE RUIN... what could be next?

notes.title: Be a gecko and climb on any surface in The Gecko Gods
notes.content:
The cat game reigned supreme in 2022, but there's a chance 2023 could be the year of the gecko game. That's how I feel after watching the trailer for The Gecko Gods, at least. It's an action adventure in which you control a cute little lizard who can crawl across walls and ceilings, and also solves puzzles, fights golems and pilots a boat.

Read more

notes.title: The Gecko Gods has a publisher! 🦎✨
notes.content:
Ryan from Super Rare Originals here! 

We're sooooo excited to announce that we're the brand new 'indie-first' publishing label behind The Gecko Gods!

Louis and his team are so incredibly talented, and just like all of you, we fell in love with the idea of exploring an ancient world as a tiny lizard.

We'll also be bringing Grapple Dog, Lone Ruin, Completely Stretchy, and POST VOID to consoles + Steam - so keep your eyes peeled! 👀

More info on The Gecko Gods will be coming soon.

If you haven't already, please wishlist The Gecko Gods - wishlists help a whoooole lot! 💙
